term: Special Interest Group on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining
definition: SIGKDD, representing the Association for Computing Machinery's (ACM) Special Interest Group (SIG) on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining, hosts an influential annual conference..
details: SIGKDD, representing the Association for Computing Machinery's (ACM) Special Interest Group (SIG) on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining, hosts an influential annual conference.

explainer.lead: SIGKDD is the Association for Computing Machinery's Special Interest Group on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining. It matters because it hosts an influential annual conference.

tiers.eli5: It is a professional group for people who find patterns in large collections of data, and it runs a big yearly meeting.
tiers.practitioner: The group represents ACM's interest in knowledge discovery and data mining and centres its activity on an influential annual conference. No specific practical pitfall is stated.
tiers.paperLevel: SIGKDD, representing the ACM's Special Interest Group on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining, hosts an influential annual conference. No formula or stated limits are given.

explainer.example: Presenting knowledge-discovery and data-mining work at SIGKDD's annual conference is the group's central activity as described.
